For the first three, block-triangular decomposition reduces to the common \(3\times3\) determinant \(-1\); direct expansion verifies the final two determinants \(1\). Since task 67 identifies the selected rows with the full row lattice, each unimodular projection onto the non-\(H\) columns leaves \(H\) as a primitive quotient generator.
